home.faqTitle: Planning home services in DFW: common questions

faqs.q: Is Homefront Journal a home-service contractor?
faqs.a: Homefront Journal is a homeowner resource and referral platform associated with Poolburg and Supremacy Service. Our guides help you plan and compare work; confirm the provider, availability and service agreement directly before booking.

faqs.q: Where can I find guidance for my city?
faqs.a: Our city guides cover Dallas, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Fort Worth and Arlington. Start with a service category to browse its city pages. A city guide is a planning resource, not confirmation of an appointment or coverage at every address.

faqs.q: What should I prepare before requesting a quote?
faqs.a: Record the symptoms, when they started and any recent changes. Gather photos only where safe and accessible, and share your city or ZIP code. Ask for a written scope, diagnosis, exclusions and terms so you can understand the proposed work.

faqs.q: Are the calculators exact prices or service recommendations?
faqs.a: No. The tools calculate planning estimates from your measurements and rates, with visible assumptions. They do not provide an installed service price or determine equipment sizing, chemical doses or electrical capacity. Confirm project requirements with the appropriate professional.

about.title: We're building the guide we wish existed.
about.subtitle: Homefront Journal is a home-services resource for people who just want a straight answer.
about.lead: Homefront Journal is a DFW homeowner resource and referral platform, produced alongside our service brands, Poolburg and Supremacy Service. We publish practical guides and connect service requests with providers.
about.whyBody1: The internet is full of home-services content that's either outdated, padded with filler, or written to sell you something. Google "how often to service your pool" and you'll get five different answers and three thinly-disguised ads.
about.whyBody2: We built Homefront around practical questions: what does the job include, what changes the price, and what should you ask before approving work? When you need help, we also offer a route to service providers, including our own brands.
about.quote: Understand the scope before you compare the price.
about.howBody: Our guides explain common service decisions, quote exclusions, and questions to ask. Technical references are linked where used. Published guidance is a starting point; a provider needs to assess your property before confirming scope or price.
about.value1Body: Guides are written to inform, not to sell. If you never hire anyone, we've still done our job.
about.value2Body: We explain what changes an estimate and distinguish planning information from a provider’s written quote.
about.value3Body: We disclose our own brands and explain where service requests go.
about.value4Body: We're built for the DFW metroplex, not a national template. City-specific costs, region-specific advice.
about.whoBody: Homefront Journal is produced alongside Poolburg and Supremacy Service. Requests can be referred to these brands. Read Our Brands to understand that relationship before requesting service.
about.ctaSub: Get matched with a vetted local pro in under a minute.

ourBrands.title: Who we work with.
ourBrands.subtitle: Homefront Journal is a homeowner resource and referral platform. Here's exactly who we connect you with — and why.
ourBrands.intro: We're transparent about how our network works. Some of the pros we connect you with are part of our own family of companies. Others are trusted partners we've worked with for years. Every single one meets the same vetting standard.
ourBrands.poolburgBody: Poolburg is our DFW-focused pool services brand. CPO-certified technicians, licensed and insured in Texas, specializing in weekly service, equipment repair, and pool remodeling across the metroplex.
ourBrands.supremacyBody: Supremacy Service is our full-service field brand. From plumbing and HVAC to pest control, electrical, holiday lighting, and landscape — Supremacy covers the rest of your property with the same standard we apply to pools.
ourBrands.partnersBody: Beyond our own brands, we work with a select group of independent local pros. They meet the same vetting standard: licensed, insured, and reviewed by our team. We don't list them publicly — we route to them the same way we route to our own brands, based on what you need and where you are.
ourBrands.trustBody: Whether the pro is part of our own family of companies or an independent partner, you get the same vetting, the same transparency, and the same quality bar. That's the whole point of Homefront.
ourBrands.ctaSub: Get matched with a vetted local pro in under a minute.
